blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Visual token pruning for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) appears highly effective, with existing methods retaining over 95% of unpruned performance on common VQA benchmarks using a quarter of the visual tokens or fewer. However, our extensive evaluation of ten methods across three MLLM families and five ability groups reveals a critical gap: strong general performance often comes at the cost of severe degradation on fine-grained tasks such as OCR and visual grounding. We trace these failures to two limitations of the prevailing paradigm of retaining the highest-ranked native patches. A single importance ranking overlooks the complementary evidence required by different tasks, while sparse patch selection disrupts both image content and spatial integrity. To address these limitations, we propose Bifocal, a training-free, two-stage pruning method built on a mixed-granularity framework. It allocates separate budgets to query-focused and image-intrinsic evidence, complemented by a pooled coarse representation of the entire image. Before the LLM, Bifocal matches question words to visual regions through a soft conjunction balanced against norm-debiased image saliency, while selecting image-intrinsic evidence to maximize representational coverage. Inside the LLM, it further prunes tokens using density-adjusted text-to-image attention. With roughly a quarter of the original visual tokens, Bifocal is the only evaluated method to retain over 90% of unpruned performance in every ability group across all three models, and ranks first on average in all nine model-budget settings. The code is available at: https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Bifocal

blocks.en: 1 Related Work
blocks.zh: 1 相关工作

blocks.en: Within an LLM, textual hidden states progressively integrate linguistic context and visual information through multiple layers of causal self-attention. A simple and computationally efficient strategy is therefore to use the final text token as a proxy for the full instruction and estimate visual token importance from its attention to visual tokens [ 3 , 51 , 7 ] . Building on this idea, subsequent methods select or aggregate multiple text tokens to extract task-relevant textual cues for visual token pruning [ 58 , 38 , 25 ] . Beyond directly reusing existing textual hidden states, some studies explicitly construct or learn text-conditioned representations for visual token pruning. IVTP [ 14 ] constructs a pseudo-CLS token that is semantically associated with the current instruction and uses it as a reference for visual token selection. LVPruning [ 42 ] introduces learnable cross-attention modules to explicitly fuse textual and visual representations and predict visual token retention decisions.
blocks.zh: 在LLM中,文字隐藏状态通过多层次的因果自觉,逐渐融合了语言背景和视觉信息. 因此,一个简单而有计算效率的战略是使用最终文本符号作为全部指令的代名词,并估计其注意力对视觉符号的重要性[3,51,7]. 基于这一想法,后续方法选择或汇总多个文本符号来取出与任务相關的文本提示来进行可视化的符号回推 [58, 38, 25]. 除了直接重用已存在的文本隐藏状态外,一些研究还明确构建或学习了文字条件化的表达方式来进行可视化的代币活化. IVTP [14] 构造了伪CLS符号,与当前指令有分解联系,并用作视觉符号选择的参考. LVPruning [42] 引入了可学习的交叉注意模块,以明确将文字和视觉表现连接起来并预测视觉符号保留决定.

blocks.en: Before visual features enter the LLM, instruction embeddings have not undergone deep contextualization or extensive interaction with the current visual input, although pretrained vision encoders and modality projectors already provide a certain degree of cross-modal semantic alignment. Accordingly, methods such as TRIM [ 40 ] exploit embedding-level text–vision relevance by measuring the similarity between CLIP text embeddings and visual patch embeddings, while subsequent approaches apply pooling or aggregation to derive text–vision relevance scores [ 56 , 12 , 26 ] . Rather than treating the entire instruction as a single unit, CRISP [ 20 ] extracts keywords and compares them with projected visual tokens, whereas ICCTP [ 55 ] uses instruction nouns as visual-semantic anchors for cross-modal clustering and visual token compression.
blocks.zh: 在视觉特性进入LLM之前,指令嵌入没有经过深层的上下文化或与当前视觉输入的广泛互动,尽管被预先训练的视觉编码器和模式投影器已经提供了一定的跨模式语义对接. 因此,TRIM[40]等方法通过测量CLIP文本嵌入和视觉补丁嵌入之间的相似性来利用嵌入级文本-视觉相关性,而后出的方法则采用集合或聚合法来得出文本-视觉相关性分数[56,12,26]. CRISP[20]不把整个指令作为一个单单元对待,而是取出关键词并将其与预测的可视化符号相提并论,而ICCTP[55]则使用指令名词作为可视化-语义主锚进行跨模式集群和可视化符号压缩.

blocks.en: Unlike methods conditioned on the current textual instruction, image-guided approaches compress visual tokens solely according to intrinsic visual cues, such as saliency, informativeness, similarity, and redundancy. One line of work estimates visual token saliency from the attention maps produced by the vision encoder. A common strategy is to use the attention from the CLS token to image patches to identify visually important tokens [ 36 ] . HiPrune [ 24 ] further exploits distinct attention patterns across different vision-encoder layers to capture object-level and global visual information, while EntropyPrune [ 44 ] measures visual token informativeness from an information-theoretic perspective using representation entropy. Another line of work focuses on similarity and redundancy among visual tokens, reducing repeated information by retaining representative or diverse visual features [ 53 , 1 ] . VisPruner [ 57 ] combines these two types of visual cues by first selecting salient tokens according to visual attention and then removing redundant tokens based on feature similarity.
blocks.zh: 与以当前文字指示为条件的方法不同,图像制导方法完全根据内在视觉提示来压缩视觉符号,如显性,信息性,相似性和冗余等. 一行工作从视觉编码器制作的注意力图中估算出视觉标志的显著性. 一个共同的战略是利用CLS符号的注意力来给图像补丁来识别视觉上重要的符号 [36]. HiPrune [24] 进一步利用不同视觉-编码层的截然不同的注意模式来捕捉对象级别和全球视觉信息,而EntropyPrune [44] 从信息-理论角度,利用表达式 en来测量视觉符号信息. 另一行工作侧重于视觉符号的相似性和冗余性,通过保留代表性或多样性的视觉特征来减少重复信息[53, 1]. VisPruner [57] 结合了这两类视觉提示,首先根据视觉注意力选择出显著的标志,再根据特征相似性去除多余的标志.

blocks.en:
Some approaches jointly exploit textual and visual cues for visual token compression. Multi-stage pruning strategies naturally fall into this category because they use complementary guidance signals at different compression stages. MustDrop [ 25 ] first removes redundant tokens according to visual similarity during visual encoding and subsequently leverages textual semantics to further filter visual information. DUET-VLM [ 38 ] first performs redundancy-aware merging based on correlations among visual tokens and then applies progressive pruning within the LLM using text-to-vision attention.
Another line of work combines textual and visual signals within a unified selection process to estimate visual token importance. AdaV [ 12 ] and CrisPrune [ 29 ] both use ViT CLS–patch self-attention to characterize visual saliency and the cosine similarity between visual tokens and text embeddings to estimate textual relevance. AdaV aggregates textual relevance using the maximum similarity, whereas CrisPrune further combines the two signals into a token-quality score. CoIn [ 6 ] measures intrinsic visual saliency using the ℓ 2 \ell_{2} norm of visual token embeddings and evaluates textual relevance through the cosine similarity between visual tokens and the mean-pooled text embedding. The two normalized scores are then combined to obtain an overall informativeness score.
blocks.zh:
有些方法共同利用文字和视觉提示进行视觉符号压缩. 多相穿透策略自然属于这一类,因为它们在不同压缩阶段使用辅助制导信号. MustDrop [25]首先根据视觉编码过程中的视觉相似性去除冗余符号,并随后利用文字语义来进一步过滤视觉信息. DUET-VLM [38] 首先根据视觉符号之间的关联性进行冗余-感知合并,再在LLM内部使用文本到视觉的注意来应用渐进式的穿透.
另一行工作将文字信号和视觉信号结合在一个统一的选择过程中来估计视觉符号的重要性. AdaV [12]和CrisPrune [29] 都使用VIT CLS-patch自觉来描述视觉的显著性,以及视觉符号和文本嵌入之间的同心相似性来估计文本的相关性. AdaV使用最大相近性来汇总文字相关性,而CrisPrune则将两个信号进一步组合成一个符号质量分数. CoIn [6] 利用可视化符号嵌入的l 2\ell\\2}规范来测量内在的可视化显著性,并通过可视化符号与正集合式文本嵌入的相同性来评价文本的相关性. 然后将两个正常的分数合并,以获得总的信息分数。

blocks.en: 2 Mixed-Granularity Pruning Framework
blocks.zh: 2 混合偏好 运行框架

blocks.en: 2.1 Information: Two Sources
blocks.zh: 2.1 资料:两个来源

blocks.en: Existing training-free pruning methods often exhibit pronounced task-wise biases [ 7 , 4 ] . We therefore turn the question around: what visual evidence does an LLM actually need to solve different tasks?
blocks.zh: 现有无培训的打压方法往往表现出明显的任务偏差[7、4]。 因此,我们转过头来问:一个LLM实际上需要什么视觉证据来解决不同的任务?

blocks.en: At inference time, a training-free pruning method has access to only two sources of information: the image itself and the question. We therefore examine how token selections driven by each source behave under the same budget. We fix the token budget at one quarter of the visual tokens and turn each source into a route with a common, simple scoring rule: the image route ranks patches by CLS attention, and the text route ranks them by their cosine similarity to the mean word embedding of the question.
blocks.zh: 推论时,一种无训练的穿行方法只能获得两个信息来源:图像本身和问题. 因此,我们审查每个来源推动的象征性选择如何在同一个预算下进行。 我们把符号预算固定在可视符号的四分之一上,把每个源变成一个具有共同的,简单的打分规则的路由:图像路由通过CLS的注意来排序补丁,而文本路由则通过他们的同位素相似性来排序它们与嵌入问题的平均单词.

blocks.en: Figure 2 (left) shows that the two routes retain noticeably different regions, and their selections overlap only slightly. Figure 2 (right) shows that this difference is systematic across tasks: OCR and document tasks favour the image route, REC tasks favour the text route, and the general benchmarks show much smaller gaps. Relying on either source alone therefore leads to a clear task-wise bias, which suggests that the two sources provide complementary rather than interchangeable evidence. We further include two references: random retention and an even split of the budget between the two routes. The even-split curve largely tracks the upper envelope of the two single-route curves; its advantage is not concentrated on any particular task but lies in robustness across tasks. Appendix A analyses the effect of each single route.

A layer of pooled coarse tokens addresses both deficiencies at once: each
coarse token summarizes content that would otherwise be discarded, while
together they restore an even positional layout over the image. The strong

blocks.en: 3.1 Query-Focused Evidence
blocks.zh: 3.1 查询 证据

blocks.en:
Query-focused evidence assigns each patch a question-dependent score I j I_{j} and
retains the top- K K patches as the evidence the question needs. Existing
methods typically compress the question into a single vector and score each
patch by its cosine similarity to it. Whether the words are pooled by a max or
a mean, a strong match to one word can stand in for the absence of another,
an or -like rule under which a “red shirt” is no different from a red fire
hydrant elsewhere in the image.
Since no model reads the question as a sentence before the LLM, we treat it as
a set of words and model two ingredients explicitly: word weighting and
word conjunction. For weighting, we invite the image back to sit on the
jury alongside the question: a word earns a louder voice when its saliency map
agrees with what the image itself finds salient. For conjunction, we combine the words with a geometric
mean, a soft and that favours patches supported by all relevant words jointly.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
This paper approaches visual token pruning from a novel perspective and
proposes a mixed-granularity pruning framework before the LLM, composed of
query-focused evidence, image-intrinsic evidence and a coarse context, which
preserves the abilities of the model more comprehensively. Building on this
framework, we optimise the selection of each kind of token. We combine the word
and image saliency maps to better preserve query-focused evidence through word
weighting and word conjunction, then select the optimal token subset by
representational coverage, and finally add a coarse context pooled from the
remaining patches. Together with Stage 2, which further removes redundant
tokens inside the LLM, Bifocal achieves the best overall performance across
multiple models and budgets.

blocks.en: For the text route, we use a deletion test to ask the most direct question: can we do without it? Starting from the unpruned sequence of 576 576 visual tokens, we remove equal numbers of tokens selected by the text route, the image route, or at random, while progressively increasing the number removed. Figure 7 shows a consistent trend across eight REC splits: at low removal rates, random deletion has only a limited effect, whereas removing text-route tokens causes Acc @ 0.5 0.5 to drop sharply, usually faster than removing image-route tokens. The text route may not carry the majority of the evidence, but it provides query-specific evidence that grounding cannot do without—if the model does not know what the question refers to, how can it draw the box accurately? As the removal rate approaches one half, the curves of the two evidence routes gradually converge. At this point, large-scale information loss begins to dominate, and which route the removed tokens come from is no longer the main issue. This further supports our conclusion in the main text: the two evidence routes cannot substitute for each other and should each be allocated their own share of the fixed budget.

blocks.en:
However well the text route is optimised, what it keeps is still word-level
evidence: before the LLM there is no real understanding of the question, so
the route can only keep the patches that look like the words it was given.
This fails in two ways: the object the question refers to is not in the image
at all, or the answer sits on something the question never names (or the
question has no target to begin with). In both cases, selecting tokens purely
by word similarity means that, under a reduced budget, the model is shown the
wrong evidence, and hallucination follows. This is exactly what the image
route is for: it does not read the question, and its wider view brings a more
diverse sample of the scene into the budget.

blocks.en:
The starting point is simple. Pruning keeps the top- m m cells by score, and 576 576 cells compete for that small handful of seats at the upper tail. If the
score of each cell has picked up the perturbation that comes with computing a
cosine, the quality of the top- k k suffers. This section is therefore about
three things: that the noise exists, that a simple averaging operation can
filter it out, and that this operation is safe, since the low-pass filter does
not remove the information that matters.

blocks.en:
Which cells of a cosine map are content and which are jitter can be told
apart by a property that requires no labels: the two spread over different
ranges. Content is contiguous—an object always occupies several cells, so
the values of neighbouring cells are correlated—whereas estimation jitter
is independent from cell to cell and is already unrelated one cell away. The
vague question of whether there is noise, and how much, thus becomes a
measurable one: how much of the variance in the map lives only at the scale
of a single cell.

The derivation predicts that raw CLS attention hands its top ranks to
high-norm patches, which mostly lie on the background, and that removing the
norm-explained component returns these ranks to the content.
Figure 10 illustrates this step from left to right on three
cases. The two
panels on the left are what one sees when raw CLS is borrowed as
a content criterion: many of the bright cells fall on sea, grass, sky and
other background, and most of the top- 80 80 seats go to them. The middle
panel shows why. The 576 576 points spread along a rising line — attention
does follow norm — and that line is the baseline to be subtracted. The
largest-norm cells are thrown far out to the right and almost all of them
lie outside the box, so their score is bought by norm. The cells inside the
box, in contrast, crowd into the low-norm side and float above the line,
and it is the part above the baseline that counts as content. Subtracting
the baseline deducts the more from a cell the larger its norm, so the
cells at the right end fall the furthest and those inside the box rise
relative to them. The two panels on the right are the result of that
subtraction: sink cells have not disappeared, but the background is
markedly weakened and the seats have returned to the target. Nor should
they disappear — they were never pushed below the line, and a sink is
not meaningless to begin with, it aggregates information from the whole
image.

blocks.en:
The anyres backbone is a harder test: it splits each image into a
variable number of crops, so the visual sequence is about four times longer
than on LLaVA-1.5 and varies across images, and a fixed token budget no longer
corresponds to a fixed fraction of the sequence. As shown in
Tables 8 and 9 , the gap between
general and grounding performance widens further on this backbone. On the
general benchmarks all methods fall within a narrow band, and even at the
160-token budget the baselines differ by at most 10.9 10.9 points in Avg., whereas
on grounding, Avg. ranges from 3.1 % 3.1\% to 52.1 % 52.1\% . At this budget, VisionZip
reaches a general Avg. of 78.2 % 78.2\% , close to the 79.8 % 79.8\% of Bifocal, yet
retains only 3.1 % 3.1\% on grounding, about 17 × 17\times lower than ours. General
VQA is therefore largely insensitive to which tokens are retained, while
grounding exposes the difference. Moreover, the four baselines that prune once
before the LLM (VisionZip, HiPrune, EADP and SID) perform similarly on
grounding at every budget, whether or not they use the query text, suggesting
that where the budget is spent in the pipeline matters more than text
awareness.

OK-VQA [32] (英语).
OK-VQA评价基于知识的视觉问题回答,其中的回答往往需要外部或常识的知识,超出图像中直接可观察到的信息.

blocks.en:
ScienceQA [ 30 ] .
ScienceQA evaluates multimodal scientific reasoning over questions from natural science, social science, and language domains, requiring models to combine visual understanding with contextual and domain knowledge.
blocks.zh:
科学QA [30].
科学 QA对来自自然科学,社会科学,语言领域的问题进行多模式科学推理评价,要求模型将视觉理解与上下文和域知识相结合.

blocks.en:
AI2D [ 19 ] .
AI2D evaluates diagram understanding and reasoning over scientific illustrations, requiring models to interpret visual components, textual labels, symbols, and their structural relationships.
blocks.zh:
AI2D [19] (英语).
AI2D评价图解和推理相对于科学插图,要求模型解释视觉组件,文字标签,符号,及其结构关系.

blocks.en:
TextVQA [ 39 ] .
TextVQA evaluates visual question answering over text-rich natural images, requiring models to recognize scene text and reason jointly over textual and surrounding visual information.
blocks.zh:
TextVQA [39] (英语).
TextVQA评价视觉问题在文本丰富的自然图像上回答,要求模型在文本和周围视觉信息上共同识别场景文本和理性.

blocks.en:
OCRBench [ 28 ] .
OCRBench evaluates OCR-related capabilities of multimodal large language models across text recognition, scene-text understanding, document understanding, and information extraction.
blocks.zh:
OCR Bench [28] (英语).
OCR Bench评价了跨文本识别、场景文本理解、文档理解和信息提取的多式大型语言模型与OCR相关的能力。

blocks.en:
DocVQA [ 34 ] .
DocVQA evaluates question answering over document images, emphasizing text recognition, layout understanding, information localization, and reasoning over structured document content.
blocks.zh:
DocVQA [34] (英语).
DocVQA评价对文档图像的回答问题,强调文本识别,布局理解,信息本地化,以及结构化文档内容的推理.

blocks.en:
ChartQA [ 33 ] .
ChartQA evaluates question answering over chart images, requiring models to understand chart elements and perform visual, logical, and arithmetic reasoning over the underlying data.
blocks.zh:
图QA [33].
ChartQA评价在图表图像上回答问题,要求模型理解图表元素,并对基础数据进行视觉,逻辑和算术推理.

blocks.en:
POPE [ 21 ] .
POPE is a diagnostic benchmark for object hallucination, using binary questions to test whether multimodal models incorrectly report objects that are absent from the image.
blocks.zh:
[21].
POPE是对象幻觉的诊断基准,使用二进制问题来测试多模式模型是否错误地报告图像中缺失的物体.

blocks.en:
RefCOCO [ 18 , 54 ] .
RefCOCO evaluates referring expression comprehension by requiring models to localize objects described by natural-language expressions in complex visual scenes.
blocks.zh:
(原始内容存档于2018-09-26). RefCOCO [18, 54].
RefCOCO通过要求模型在复杂的视觉场景中将自然语言表达所描述的物体本地化来对表达理解进行参考评价.

blocks.en:
RefCOCO+ [ 18 , 54 ] .
RefCOCO+ evaluates referring expression comprehension while restricting explicit location words, placing greater emphasis on object appearance, attributes, and relational cues.
blocks.zh:
参考COCO+[18,54].
RefCOCO+评价引用表达理解,同时限制明确位置的单词,更强调对象外观,属性和关系提示.

blocks.en:
RefCOCOg [ 18 , 54 ] .
RefCOCOg contains longer and more descriptive referring expressions, requiring models to integrate fine-grained object attributes and contextual relationships for accurate visual grounding.
blocks.zh:
(原始内容存档于2018-09-21). RefCOCOg [18, 54].
RefCOCOg包含更长更描述性的引用表达式,需要模型将细纹对象属性和上下文关系融合在一起,以准确的视觉地基.

blocks.en: J.3 Image-Intrinsic and Query-Focused Evidence
blocks.zh: J.3 图像内置和扫描 证据

blocks.en:
Figure 14 shows the fine evidence Bifocal selects for one
image under several POPE queries. The image-intrinsic evidence, selected from
the CLS attention, spreads over the whole image and barely changes across
queries. The query-focused evidence instead changes with the query and gathers
on the object it names. The two kinds of evidence thus play the roles they are
designed for: one covers the image, the other follows the question.
